objective: Sustain and control the second phase of the operation already underway.
intendedChange: The group establishes whether increased flow is viable and makes a consequential adjustment to manage its cost or danger.
prohibitedPatterns: Do not resolve the local Blight source or conclude the prelude.
Do not relocate the party from the Gate of Silence.
Do not invent a Keeper death or off-page character death.
Do not introduce a new external threat or pursuit.
Do not have Elias repeat the council-style planning discussion; he must coordinate in real-time.

scenes.purpose: Elias initiates the escalation to the second phase by instructing Kaelen to shift from passive listening to active pulling, while Elara and Maren increase the resonance frequency to open the channel wider.
scenes.intendedChange: The Blight flow intensifies from a trickle to a steady stream, and Kaelen begins to physically strain as the gauntlet heats up and the fog presses closer.

scenes.purpose: Elias observes the barrier's reaction to the increased volume and notices it beginning to flicker and destabilize, indicating that the barrier is reaching its capacity limit and the current approach is unsustainable.
scenes.intendedChange: The group realizes that pushing the flow further will shatter the barrier rather than consume the Blight, forcing them to halt the escalation and reassess their method.

scenes.purpose: Elias coordinates a tactical adjustment by instructing Kaelen to modulate his pull into a rhythmic, pulsing pattern rather than a continuous surge, allowing the barrier to digest the Blight in manageable bursts while Elara adjusts the chisel's frequency to match the new rhythm.
scenes.intendedChange: The barrier stabilizes and resumes consuming the Blight efficiently, and Kaelen regains a measure of control, establishing a viable but demanding method for the final phase.
